Hi! I'm Ziling, however most know me as Z! I graduated from St. Olaf College with a degree in Mathematics and a concentration in Statistics and Data Science. I currently work in analytics at Ameriprise Financial, and I’ll also be returning to St. Olaf as an assistant coach for the women’s basketball team. Outside of work and basketball, I love spending time with friends, playing pickleball, going to sporting events and concerts, and trying new foods! This is a place where I’ll be sharing some of my work and a little bit about myself.
